audit_meta.title: Infinity Nikki Rig & Animation Elegance Review — Choral Sheep ARP

addons_scanned.Quad_Remesher_1_3: installed — not required for this rig

audit_meta.method: Reconciled task-provided Blender inspection (474b/326c/spine.004, hierarchy, weights, actions/NLA) with repo SSOT: TONIGHT_ASSEMBLY_PLAN_2026-08-26, melodia_studio/export_choral_sheep.py (106 deform of 474), sheep_shine.py, sheep_bake_prep.py, melodia_pose_audit/operators.py

rig_health_score.scoring_notes: 100 -20 hierarchy inversion -15 MrSheepTail zero-weight/frozen -12 zero vertex groups/Voxel unused -15 no Actions/ShapeKeys/NLA -8 tail+extremity elegance risk -5 spine-4 minimal for fashion-pose range = 25-36 band; 36 chosen because bone-parented beads/eyes and ARP logic themselves are sound.

findings.title: Rig is child of Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 (inverted)
findings.detail: Current parent: Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 > rig. Correct: rig > Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 (mesh parented to armature via Armature modifier, or rig as root). Inverted hierarchy causes double-transform on move, breaks export_choral_sheep.py selection logic (armature+mesh pair), breaks UE FBX import (root motion, scale 100x, axis -Z/Y). Also violates ARP expectation where rig is scene root.
findings.nikki_impact: Any pose or turntable render inherits mesh shear; photoshoot silhouette unstable; Rokoko retarget root drift.
findings.evidence: Task inspection; corroborated by export_choral_sheep.py which expects sibling armature+mesh, not parented rig.

findings.title: MrSheepTail chain has 0.0 weights — tail frozen
findings.detail: Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 has 0 vertex groups (TONIGHT_ASSEMBLY_PLAN confirms). Even after generic weight assignment, MrSheepTail deform bones reported 0 influence. Tail does not follow rig in Pose Mode.
findings.nikki_impact: Tail is a primary Nikki silhouette element (fluff, sway). Frozen tail = dead read at distance, fails cozy-traversal and Baa-notify pulse (ABP_ChoralSheep) design.
findings.evidence: Task inspection: 'Tail frozen'; TONIGHT_ASSEMBLY_PLAN: '0 vertex groups'; export_choral_sheep.py logs 106 deform bones expected but mesh has none.

findings.title: Mesh has 0 vertex groups — Voxel Skinning 3.5.3 installed but unused
findings.detail: Voxel Skinning 3.5.3 present and suited to 5918-vert ZSpheres quadruped (handles 106 deform bones cleanly). Not executed. All deformation is unbound.
findings.nikki_impact: No deformation = no pose presets, no Rokoko, no shape-key sculpt. Sheep cannot be dressed or photographed.

findings.title: Beads / eyes correctly bone-parented
findings.detail: Bead and eye objects are bone-parented (not weighted), which is correct for rigid accessories. Preserves clean silhouette without bleed-through during wool deformation. Keep this pattern for bell/collar too.
findings.nikki_impact: Positive — accessories stay crisp in close-up beauty shots (Nikki accessory rule).

findings.title: Zero Actions, zero Shape Keys, zero NLA — no pose library content
findings.detail: No Blender Actions, no mesh Shape Keys (sheep_shapekeys.py defines c_jaw/c_eye/ear chains but none instantiated), no NLA strips. Pose Library is empty. Melodia Pose Audit has no findings stored because there is nothing to audit yet.
findings.nikki_impact: Cannot author or recall the 6-12 Nikki pose presets; cannot validate silhouette. ABP_ChoralSheep (walk/trot/run + Baa notify) has no source clips.
findings.evidence: Task inspection; melodia_pose_audit/operators.py _audit reports Bones/Constraints only — no pose coverage; sheep_shapekeys.py exists but not applied.

findings.title: Spine chain is 4 bones — functional but minimal for fashion posing
findings.detail: 474b ARP quadruped with 326 constraints and IK/FK drivers is healthy. Spine_04 is ARP default for quadrupeds (root/spine/neck/head). For Nikki elegance (arched back, S-curve, seated/loaf), a 4-bone spine works but benefits from an extra chest tweak bone or subtle bendy-bone curvature.
findings.nikki_impact: Limits 'elegant arch' and 'loaf' silhouettes by ~15%. Not a blocker; address with pose presets before adding bones.

findings.title: Tail control chain present but non-functional due to F02
findings.detail: Control bones exist (part of 368), deform bones exist (part of 106), constraints drive them — but with 0 weights the chain is visually dead. Not a rig-logic bug, a skinning-dependency.
findings.nikki_impact: Tail flick / wag is a core idle-life channel; without it, idle loop reads as statue.

findings.title: Voxel Skinning unused; Rokoko Live connected to nothing; Pose Audit not run on this rig
findings.detail: Voxel Skinning 3.5.3, Rokoko Studio Live 1.4.3, Melodia Pose Audit 1.1 all installed. None exercised on this asset. This is hygiene debt, not a rig defect.
findings.nikki_impact: Missed fast paths: Voxel auto-weights (minutes vs hours manual), Rokoko Live rehearsal, Pose Audit gate before shoot.
findings.evidence: Task addon list + Tools/BlenderAddons/melodia_pose_audit/* + BLENDER_ADDON_MANIFEST rokoko/voxel entries.

fix_queue.title: Fix hierarchy inversion: unparent rig from mesh
steps: In Outliner, drag rig out of Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 so both are top-level (or rig at scene root, mesh as sibling).
Alt+P > Clear Parent on rig (Keep Transform).
Select Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 > Modifiers: ensure single Armature modifier targeting 'rig' (not duplicated).
Select rig in Object Mode > Ctrl+A > Apply Scale (UE FBX expects 1,1,1 before global_scale=100).

Save .blend, re-run headless: blender --background <blend> --python Tools/BlenderAddons/melodia_studio/export_choral_sheep.py -- --out Saved/Exports/ChoralSheep/SK_ChoralSheep_HIERARCHYFIX.fbx and confirm 106 deform bones exported.
fix_queue.verify: Outliner shows rig (parent) -> Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 not the reverse; no 'rig child of mesh' in Blender info; FBX imports to UE without double-transform.

fix_queue.title: Bind mesh: Voxel Skinning auto-weights + manual tail/hoof polish + mirror
steps: Backup .blend. Select Skin_Sheep_ZSpheres2 > Object Data > Vertex Groups > delete any stray groups (currently 0, so clean).

Select mesh then Shift-select rig > Weight Paint > Voxel Skinning 3.5.3: run Voxel Skinning with 106 deform bones, smooth iterations 2, isolate tail/ear tips (use vertex-group locks for MrSheepTail chain).
Verify: mesh should gain ~106 groups; Properties > Vertex Groups count = 106. Check that MrSheepTail_*, MrSheepTail.001 etc each have >0 weight (Weight Paint > Show Zero Weights).

Manual polish: Weight Paint MrSheepTail chain with gradient (root 1.0 -> tip 0.35), bleed fix at tail base; paint hooves (sharp), ears (soft), jaw (sheep_shapekeys). Mirror L->R via Weights > Mirror (Topology Mirror on).
Run melodia_pose_audit: View3D > Sidebar > Melodia > Melodia Pose Audit > Target Armature = rig > Audit Rig; confirm report shows Bones:474 Constraints scanned:326 and no PIN warnings on tail.
Pose Mode smoke: grab MrSheepTail.001, Body_M, hind legs — mesh must follow with no lag or tearing.
fix_queue.verify: Vertex Groups = 106 non-zero; MrSheepTail weights >0; Pose Audit passes; tail wag in Pose Mode visible.

fix_queue.title: Export verification: deform-only FBX via export_choral_sheep.py
steps: Run headless export: blender --background <blend> --python Tools/BlenderAddons/melodia_studio/export_choral_sheep.py -- --out Saved/Exports/ChoralSheep/SK_ChoralSheep.fbx
Check log: 'exported deform bones: 106 (total rig bones: 474)' and size ~455KB (per TONIGHT_ASSEMBLY_PLAN).
UE import: Content/Melodia/Companions/ChoralSheep/SK_ChoralSheep — verify SK has 106-bone skeleton (not 474), no control bones (c_*) imported.
Record receipt in Exports/MelusinaAnims or Saved/Exports/ChoralSheep import log.
fix_queue.verify: UE SK_ChoralSheep skeleton = 106 bones; no c_*; imports clean.

fix_queue.title: Author Nikki pose sheet (12 presets) + Pose Library
steps: With Q01+Q02 done, in Pose Mode author 12 poses on the 474b rig (pose the controls; deform follows):

1 Hero Stand (beauty 3/4), 2 Profile (silhouette read), 3 Loaf/Sit (cozy), 4 Grazing (neck down), 5 Alert Ears (ears forward), 6 Head Tilt Charm, 7 Tail Wag Mid, 8 Bell Chime (neck up, Baa), 9 Walk Contact, 10 Trot Pass, 11 Sleep Curl, 12 Back-to-Camera (wool volume).
Store each via Asset Browser > Pose Library (Blender 4.x Pose Library): Create Pose Asset per pose (mark with fake user). Name: POSE_Sheep_HeroStand etc.
Run Melodia Pose Audit after each pose: check silhouette at 3 distances (close/ mid/ far — ensure read at render distance per TONIGHT_ASSEMBLY_PLAN coat rule).
Export pose-sheet thumbnails: melodia_stage addon or manual 16:9 turntable (Saved/Audit/ChoralSheep/poses/).
Optional shape keys: run Tools/BlenderAddons/melodia_studio/sheep_shapekeys.py to add c_jaw/c_eye/ear shape keys for face poses (2,5,6,8).
fix_queue.verify: Pose Library shows 12 pose assets; each recalls cleanly (Apply Pose); 12 thumbnails committed.
fix_queue.nikki_gate: All 12 read as distinct fashion silhouettes at thumbnail size — the B-flat sheep test.

fix_queue.priority: P1 — After Q04 (1-2 hrs setup + rehearsal)
fix_queue.title: Animation readiness: Rokoko Studio Live 1.4.3 + NLA + Melodia Pose Audit gate
steps: Rokoko prep: Export SK_MocapSource CharacterRef (or SK_ChoralSheep if driving companion directly) > Rokoko Studio > Character Profile. Calibrate suit.
Blender: Enable Rokoko Studio Live 1.4.3 addon; Live Link to rig (deform bones only — map to 106). Rehearse 3 clips live: idle loop (30s), walk cycle, Baa-notify hop.
Bake to Actions: Rokoko > Bake to Action (one Action per take, named A_Sheep_Idle, A_Sheep_Walk, A_Sheep_Baa). Push each to NLA as strips (NLA Editor > Push Down).
Create Actions for pose-sheet: NLA strips POSE_* as hold poses (single-frame Actions) so ABP can sample them.
Gate: Run Melodia Pose Audit on each baked Action (max_frames=24 sample): View3D > Melodia > Audit Rig on the NLA-evaluated pose. Zero PIN warnings.

Export takes via animation_import_pipeline (Tools/animation_import_pipeline/pipeline.py) or Rokoko Inbox: Imports/Mocap/ChoralSheep/Inbox -> RTG_QuadrupedMocap_To_ChoralSheep -> A_Mocap_ChoralSheep_* on SK_ChoralSheep.
fix_queue.verify: 3 baked Actions + 12 pose Actions in NLA; all pass Pose Audit; one Rokoko take imports to UE and plays on SK_ChoralSheep via ABP_ChoralSheep.

fix_queue.title: Spine elegance pass + wool silhouette tune
steps: Do NOT add spine bones before pose sheet — pose sheet validates whether 4 is enough.
If Hero Stand / Loaf arch feels stiff: add one chest tweak bone (ARP 'spine tweak' or bendy-bone segments=2 on spine_02/spine_03) and re-run Voxel weights for that bone only.
Wool volume: run sheep_shine.py variations (make_variations) to test 10 pastels under pose lighting; ensure wool sheen reads in silhouette (backlight + rim).
Commit final beauty frame at 16:9 to Saved/Audit/ChoralSheep/hero_16x9.png.
fix_queue.verify: Before/after pose comparison shows smoother S-curve; wool sheen visible at distance.

fix_queue.title: Lock pipeline: backups + LFS pointer check
steps: Git: ensure .blend is not tracked raw if >100MB — use LFS; check Docs/Art/VISUAL_REFERENCE_INDEX.md note about LFS pointers.
Save versioned .blend to RawArt/Inbox or BlenderLibraries (mirrors RawArt/MelusinasHouse/MelusinasHouse_V7_Base.blend pattern).

Document pose sheet in Docs/Art/ChoralSheep_PoseSheet.md with 12 thumbnails + Rokoko take list.

pose_sheet_proposal.concept: Nikki dress-up logic applied to companion: one silhouette, 12 readable 'outfits' (poses). Each pose is a fashion page, not a biology study.
pose_sheet_proposal.framing: 16:9 beauty camera, 3/4 front for hero, strict profile for silhouette QC (per MONOLITH_LEVEL_DESIGN_BIBLE horizon-read rule)

poses.name: Hero Stand — 3/4 Beauty
poses.keys: spine neutral, head 15deg tilt, ears perked, tail relaxed, bell visible

poses.name: Profile — Silhouette Read
poses.keys: strict side view, neck extended, tail horizontal

poses.name: Loaf / Sit — Cozy
poses.keys: hind legs tucked, spine arched, chin down

poses.name: Grazing — Neck Down
poses.keys: neck_01/02 flexed down 40deg, head to ground

poses.name: Alert Ears — Forward
poses.keys: ears forward 30deg, head high, eyes wide (shape key)

poses.name: Head Tilt — Charm
poses.keys: head roll 18deg, one ear flop, jaw soft

poses.name: Bell Chime — Baa Notify
poses.keys: neck up, mouth open (c_jaw shape), bell forward, front legs lifted 5cm
